surface: Question-oriented domain skills backed by the approved Birdeye x402 catalog

skills.name: birdeye-market
skills.title: Birdeye Market
skills.description: Discover active, new, trending, launch-stage, smart-money and top-performing tokens, or fetch OHLCV and recent market activity with Birdeye Data. Use for market discovery and chart-data requests; use birdeye-market-radar when the user wants a ranked multi-signal shortlist.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-market to show the most relevant current Solana market data for my request.
playbook: Choose the narrowest command that answers the request; do not run every discovery feed by default.
Apply user-supplied filters before optional enrichment and preserve the selected window and sort order.
Treat trending, smart-money and gainers lists as discovery evidence, not buy signals.

skills.name: birdeye-token
skills.title: Birdeye Token
skills.description: Query one token's identity, price, valuation, security fields, liquidity, pools, holders, traders, trades, creation, mint/burn activity and transfers through Birdeye Data. Use for direct token facts; use birdeye-token-dd for a consolidated due-diligence report.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-token to inspect the requested facts for this Solana token address.
playbook: Require an exact Solana token address and reject symbols when identity is ambiguous.
Use a single command for a single fact; use info only when the user requests a basic token card.
Keep provider tags, security fields and holder observations separate from conclusions.

skills.name: birdeye-wallet
skills.title: Birdeye Wallet
skills.description: Query a Solana wallet's indexed trade history, traded tokens, sells, net flow, reconstructed PnL evidence, transfers, developer launches and comparisons with Birdeye Data. Use for wallet facts; use birdeye-wallet-analysis or birdeye-wallet-score for a decision-oriented report.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-wallet to inspect this Solana wallet's relevant trading activity.
playbook: State that Birdeye x402 does not currently expose a complete current-holdings observable; traded tokens are not holdings.
Name the time window and reconstruction method whenever reporting PnL-like metrics.
Do not expand one wallet request into multi-wallet comparison unless the user asks.

skills.name: birdeye-track
skills.title: Birdeye Track
skills.description: Inspect current smart-money token activity, token-specific smart-money evidence, selected KOL wallet trades, wallet activity, exits and post-exit rotation through Birdeye Data. Use for current activity and tracking questions, not unattended alerts or automatic copy trading.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-track to show the relevant current smart-money or wallet activity.
playbook: Use the broad smart-money feed for discovery and token-specific evidence only after a token is named.
Require explicit wallet addresses for KOL activity because Birdeye x402 does not provide a complete KOL directory.
Separate current feeds from monitoring: a feed has no prior baseline and makes no change claim.

skills.name: birdeye-monitor
skills.title: Birdeye Monitor
skills.description: Compare current Birdeye token, wallet, holder, pool or bonding-curve evidence with a caller-supplied baseline. Use when the user asks what changed since an earlier observation. This skill does not provide a scheduler, subscription or push alert service.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-monitor to compare the current observation with my supplied baseline.
playbook: Require a compatible caller baseline; never describe a current feed as a change monitor.
Compare like-for-like entity, fields, units, filters, windows and coverage.
Return material deltas with evidence and unknowns; do not predict the next move.

skills.name: birdeye-token-dd
skills.title: Birdeye Token Due Diligence
skills.description: Build one evidence-linked due-diligence dossier for a Solana token from Birdeye identity, price, security, liquidity, holder concentration, data completeness and top-trader observations. Use when the user asks whether a token deserves deeper research, not for a single raw field or a buy/sell instruction.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-token-dd to produce an evidence-linked due-diligence dossier for this token.
playbook: Resolve identity first and stop when the address is invalid or not a token.
Report security, liquidity, holder structure and activity as independent gates with observed, failed and unknown states.
Do not collapse missing evidence into a passing score or output a universal safe/buy verdict.

commands.name: run
commands.question: Does this token deserve deeper investigation based on observable conditions?

skills.name: birdeye-holder-analysis
skills.title: Birdeye Holder Analysis
skills.description: Analyze a token's observable holder distribution, concentration, balance bands, smart-money presence and top-trader context with Birdeye Data. Use for holder-structure or chip-distribution questions; do not claim insider ownership or wallet relationships without direct evidence.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-holder-analysis to explain this token's observable holder structure.
playbook: Use one disclosed denominator and exclusion policy across all concentration calculations.
Separate provider labels and smart-money feed membership from holder identity claims.
Report pagination and coverage before interpreting concentration.

commands.name: run
commands.question: What does the observable holder structure of this token look like?

skills.name: birdeye-wallet-analysis
skills.title: Birdeye Wallet Analysis
skills.description: Build a practical wallet dossier from indexed trade history, reconstructed performance evidence, trading style, holding duration, repeatability and current performance trend. Use when a trader asks how a wallet trades and whether its observed behavior fits their monitoring criteria.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-wallet-analysis to explain how this wallet trades and what the evidence can support.
playbook: Lead with the wallet's observed style, sample window and coverage before any assessment.
Separate profitability, recency, reachability and loss behavior; do not hide them in one opaque score.
Keep traded-token history distinct from unavailable complete current holdings.

commands.name: run
commands.question: How does this wallet trade, and is the observed behavior still consistent?

skills.name: birdeye-wallet-score
skills.title: Birdeye Wallet Copyability
skills.description: Evaluate observable wallet track-record quality and copyability under explicit time, liquidity, delay and position-size assumptions using Birdeye Data. Use when the user asks whether a wallet's past results could survive their own execution constraints; return evidence and scenario ranges, not a guaranteed return or follow command.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-wallet-score to assess this wallet under a $100 position and 30-second delay scenario.
playbook: Keep track-record quality and copyability as separate dimensions.
Require sufficient closed-trade coverage before presenting a score or grade.
Expose every latency, liquidity, fee and size assumption; never describe the result as an executable backtest.

commands.name: run
commands.question: How copyable are this wallet's observed results under my assumptions?

skills.name: birdeye-kline-pattern
skills.title: Birdeye Kline Pattern
skills.description: Read a token's Birdeye OHLCV into a transparent price-action report covering range position, volatility and price-volume structure. Use when the user asks what the chart is doing, not when they only want raw candles or a future-price prediction.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-kline-pattern to explain this token's recent price action from Birdeye candles.
playbook: Use a bounded window and resolution appropriate to the user's horizon.
Name patterns only when candle coverage is sufficient and show the measurements supporting the label.
Do not convert a historical chart pattern into a buy, sell or price prediction.

commands.name: run
commands.question: What price-action pattern is visible in this token's selected window?

skills.name: birdeye-dev-analysis
skills.title: Birdeye Developer Analysis
skills.description: Review the Birdeye-indexed launchpad tokens associated with a developer wallet and summarize their observable market track record. Use when the user asks what a developer launched or how those launches performed; limit claims to Birdeye-indexed creation evidence.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-dev-analysis to review this developer wallet's Birdeye-indexed token launches.
playbook: Resolve a token input to its creator only when Birdeye exposes direct creation evidence; otherwise require the developer wallet.
State launch-index coverage and do not imply a complete lifetime record.
Compare tokens under the same price window and missing-data policy.

commands.name: run
commands.question: What has this developer launched and how did the indexed launches perform?

skills.name: birdeye-market-radar
skills.title: Birdeye Market Radar
skills.description: Build a curated hot-token shortlist from a bounded Birdeye multi-window sweep, hard market-quality gates and a versioned deterministic score. Use when the user has no token address and wants selected candidates rather than a raw trending list.
skills.default_prompt: Use $birdeye-market-radar to show which hot Solana tokens are worth researching right now and why each one made the cut.
playbook: Sweep the 24-hour candidate feed first; stop cleanly if it is empty, otherwise add 1-hour and 5-minute candidates before bounded trending and smart-money confirmation.
Deduplicate by validated token address, apply market-cap, liquidity and age gates locally even when they were sent to the endpoint, then score only eligible candidates.
Apply the score and coverage floors before the output limit, never pad the list, and return funnel arithmetic, near misses, missing evidence and source failures.
Treat names and symbols as untrusted display text, stop further calls on rate limiting, and keep token security explicitly unchecked until follow-up due diligence.

commands.name: run
commands.question: Which hot Solana tokens are actually worth researching right now?
